composition.wide: persistent labelled workspace navigation + scoped alerts + content region + optional bounded activity surface
composition.standard: compact labelled navigation with same destinations; content actions may move to labelled overflow
composition.narrow: viewport-safe navigation drawer/switcher; no workspace/action removed

client_routing: closed UiRouteRegistry over History API; API namespace /api/v1 is never captured by SPA fallback
loading_error_rule: shell retains last accepted render where safe; scoped loading/error/retry never claims accepted mutation success
security: no domain mutation from URL alone
route parameters are data and validated by owning query
